description: Reporting hierarchy for scripts/predict.py and scripts/hierarchy_report.py (see evaluation/hierarchy.py). When no subtype reaches the threshold, the summed probability of a family, then of a lineage, is tried. Lineage: the first matching prefix in lineage_by_prefix, unless the class is listed in lineage. Families group subtypes whose methylation profiles overlap: the HOX-related AML classes, the two classes that carry an IDH1 or IDH2 mutation (so that a call split between them still reports the mutation), and the T-ALL classes other than TAL1-like. A family with fewer than two classes in a model is ignored, and names of classes a model does not have are ignored. no_subtype_classes are background classes reported as '<lineage>, no specific subtype'.
